column1: # PR-09 §2's pre-registered embodiment-fidelity corpus for T-041.
# ONE ROW PER SOURCE:  <hf_repo_id>  <camera_key>  <licence>
# Tab-separated. '#' comments and blank lines ignored.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The repo list and the camera list used to be two bash arrays in
# 92_fetch_g1_corpus.sbatch, matched by POSITION. That is a data structure held together by
# nothing: delete one line from either array and every source after it silently gets its
# neighbour's camera. A generator trained on a wrist camera when we meant the head view is a
# finite, plausible, wrong run that no metric flags. Pairing them on one line removes the failure
# mode rather than warning about it. Both the cluster job and the workstation pipeline read this
# file, so the two paths cannot disagree about what the corpus is either.
# THE CAMERA IS A CHOICE, NOT A DEFAULT. The Unitree sets ship 2 or 4 views. cam_left_high is the
# head-mounted view: it sees the torso, both arms and the Dex3 hands doing the task, which is the
# embodiment signal PR-09 §2 is buying. The wrist cameras see the object and almost nothing of the
# robot, so they answer "what is being manipulated" rather than "which robot is manipulating it".
# cam_right_high is the other half of the same stereo pair — usable, redundant, and mixing the two
# would put near-duplicate frames in both the train and val splits.
# CODEC: every one of these is AV1 (checked 2026-08-08 in each meta/info.json). That is LeRobot's
# default and it is NOT safely consumable — vLLM's OpenCV decoded zero frames from it and job
# 186357 produced 0 captions from 372 clips without erroring. The corpus must be transcoded to
# H.264 (prepare_cosmos_corpus.py --mode transcode) before anything reads it.
# FORMAT: AppleToPlate is LeRobot v2.1 (one mp4 per episode). All 13 Unitree sets are v3.0
# (episodes concatenated, boundaries in meta/episodes/*/*.parquet). prepare_cosmos_corpus.py
# dispatches on the declared codebase_version; it does not guess from the layout.
# NOT INTERCHANGEABLE. Swapping a source changes which experiment this is and needs its own
# pre-registration. USC-PSI-Lab/Humanoid-Everyday-G1 was added by operator decision on 2026-08-07
# and withdrawn on 2026-08-08 — see PR-09 §2, which carries both dated notes. Do not re-add it
# without reading them.
